tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand JChatMind — a Spring Boot + React Agent chat system with RAG, authentication, user memory, and agent harness features.

tour.title: Infrastructure & Docker
tour.description: Docker Compose orchestrates PostgreSQL+pgvector, Redis, RabbitMQ, and Ollama for local development. The Ollama Dockerfile auto-pulls BGE-M3 for embeddings.

tour.title: Backend Entry Point
tour.description: The Spring Boot application entry point and Maven build configuration with all dependencies: Spring AI, MyBatis, Security, Redis, RabbitMQ, MCP.

tour.title: Configuration & Security
tour.description: Spring Boot configuration, JWT authentication, rate limiting, and async email verification with RabbitMQ.

tour.title: Agent Orchestration
tour.description: Agent creation, Think-Execute loop, tool execution, harness (approval/circuit-breaker/audit), and SSE event streaming to the frontend.

tour.title: REST Controllers
tour.description: HTTP API endpoints for chat, agents, knowledge bases, user memory, harness approval, and authentication.

tour.title: Business Services
tour.description: Core business logic: RAG retrieval pipeline, query rewrite, user memory management, chat session management, and document ingestion.

tour.title: Data Access (MyBatis)
tour.description: MyBatis mapper interfaces and XML SQL definitions for PostgreSQL tables including pgvector similarity search for RAG.

tour.title: Domain Models & DTOs
tour.description: JPA entities, DTOs, and value objects representing agents, chat messages, knowledge bases, user memories, and RAG retrieval results.

tour.title: MCP Integration
tour.description: Model Context Protocol server exposing knowledge base retrieval and email tools to external clients like Notion.

tour.title: Frontend (React + Vite)
tour.description: React 19 TypeScript UI with Ant Design 6 and Tailwind CSS 4: agent chat, knowledge base management, user memory views, and authentication.

tour.title: Database Migrations
tour.description: SQL migration scripts for authentication tables, user memory schema, and email failure logging.

tour.title: Tests & RAG Evaluation
tour.description: RAG recall evaluation with diversity metrics, multi-document fixtures, and answer quality assessment using LLM-as-judge.

tour.title: Documentation
tour.description: Architecture plans, bug fix records, RAG evaluation baselines, and reference materials for the project.
